about_the_game:
This is the playable demo for the game "Inspiring Dreams".

A man becomes a ghost after a deadly accident. Full of regrets, he will stay alongside his wife, who cannot see him, and protect her all her life from an unknown evil, sharing her best and worst moments. So close yet so far.

Will he find a way to talk to her again?

A story-driven experience full of emotions and poetry.

A game made by a single person.

Key Features

  • Strong focus on story to give the best experience possible.
  • RPG elements that balance story and gameplay.
  • Detailed and colorful pixel-art.
  • Beautiful soundtrack that closely ties to the story.
  • A mysterious talking skull.

Music credit for the trailer
Keys of Moon (Serjo De Lua) - Gentle feelings. Listen to his music on SoundCloud or YouTube.
